defective_pattern: Hardcoding generic font defaults (e.g., B Nazanin 14 pt, B Titr 16 pt, 1.0-inch margins) when processing manuscripts.
why_defective: Ignores explicit institutional typography templates (e.g., Thesis.docx or help.pdf) which mandate specific font families (e.g., B Lotus) and exact centimeter-based margins (e.g., Top/Bottom/Right 3.0 cm, Left 2.0 cm), leading to format rejection by the graduate school.
observed_symptoms: Generated DOCX files default to B Nazanin instead of the institutional standard.
Margins are set to generic 1-inch instead of specific metric margins.
Title pages and headings disregard institutional hierarchy.
corrective_remedy: Before applying typography, explicitly extract institutional typography rules from 01_raw_inputs/help.pdf or baseline Thesis.docx. Apply the extracted fonts (e.g., B Lotus) and margins dynamically.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of hardcoded 'B Nazanin' or 'B Titr' or '1 inch' assignments without verifying the institutional template.
